blurb: Sati Yoga & Wellness offers non-heated mindful yoga classes suitable for all levels and abilities, focusing on breathwork, meditation, and mindful movement. Classes include gentle, restorative, yin, slow flow, and dynamic flow yoga, as well as Reiki healing sessions. The studio emphasizes accessibility, trauma-informed practices, and community building.
extraNote: Door locks 5 minutes after class start time; arrive 5-10 minutes early if new to complete paperwork · Discounted memberships available upon email request for financial support · At the studio located at 1996 Hosea L Williams Dr NE, between Kirkwood Feed and Dulce Vegan Bakery.
